name: ui-interactive-cli
description: Interactive CLI session with readline loop, slash commands, and optional shell mode

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

shellMode.description: When enabled, lines starting with a recognized system command are executed directly instead of sent to the agent.

pasteMarkerMinChars.description: Minimum length (characters) for a single-line paste to be shown as a [Paste #N] marker; shorter single-line pastes (with any surrounding newlines trimmed) are inserted into the line as-is. Set to 0 to always use the marker.

renderer.description: Interactive CLI output renderer (default on). 'split' mounts the managed bottom-region renderer (commits transcript rows into native scrollback) but only when both stdin and stdout are TTYs and TERM is not the dumb convention string; any non-TTY stream or dumb terminal falls back to legacy regardless of this knob. 'legacy' is the kill-switch: today's direct stdout/stderr writes, byte-identical, never touches a global.

markdown.description: Highlight markdown in streamed assistant prose on the split renderer (headings, **strong**, `code`, list markers, fenced blocks with shell/yaml sub-highlighting). Default on; set false for the flat final_response wash. Ignored on the legacy renderer and when colors are disabled.

cli:flags.description: Execute lines starting with a recognized system command directly
Disable markdown highlighting of assistant prose (split renderer; config uiInteractiveCli.markdown)
